Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.q: How many zones does the Kestrel-7 support?
Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.answer: The Kestrel-7 supports up to 24 zones [1].

Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.q: What power supply does the Kestrel-7 use?
Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.answer: The Kestrel-7 runs on a 12 V DC supply [1].

Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.q: How often does the Kestrel-7 log soil moisture?
Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.answer: The Kestrel-7 logs soil moisture every 15 minutes [2].

Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.q: How long is the warranty on the Kestrel-7 moisture sensors?
Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.answer: The warranty on the Kestrel-7 moisture sensors is 1 year [3].

Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.q: How can data be exported from the Kestrel-7?
Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.answer: Data can be exported from the Kestrel-7 over USB-C only [2].

Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.q: Which model added Wi-Fi export and how many zones does it support?
Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.answer: The Kestrel-9 added Wi-Fi export [4] and supports up to 48 zones [4].

Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.q: Is there phone support for Kestrel devices?
Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.answer: No, there is no phone support for Kestrel devices [5].

Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.q: What programming language is the Kestrel-7 firmware written in?
Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.answer: The Kestrel-7 firmware is written in Rust [1].

Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.q: How long is data stored on the Kestrel-7 before it is overwritten?
Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite.answer: Data is stored on the Kestrel-7 for 90 days before it is overwritten [2].
